_comment: Run rules of the generic dungeon runner, keyed by DungeonTemplate name; rooms are named by their DungeonTemplate room title (m_Title). 'answer_events' maps a conversation ServerScriptEvent (sent by the client as a campaign sendevent) to points for the room being talked to; 'boss_form_by_total' picks the finale scene variant from the run's point total (the first band whose upper bound is >= the total wins). 'difficulty_by_rank' swaps a room battle's trailing variant word by the battle's rank in the run (1st, 2nd, ... room cleared). 'rooms' holds per-room rules: 'on' maps a ServerScriptEvent of the room's conversation to 'fight' (the room's battle), 'skip' (the room is done without a battle), 'leave' (nothing happens, the room stays to be done later) or {'scene': <EncounterScene name>} (that battle instead); 'requires_any'/'requires_all' name the rooms that open it; 'optional' rooms are not needed to open the finale (which otherwise waits for every other room); 'encounter_by_cleared' picks the battle by which rooms are done (first match wins). The events are the conversations' own (client ConversationTemplate m_OnSelectedEvents); what each one leads to follows the HEX Revival progression notes (github.com/Theveninm/Hex-shard-of-fates-revival docs/PROGRESSION.md, Dungeons.cs).

_lives._comment: Dungeon lives (client TalentManager.GetTotalDungeonLives): 3 plus every talent's ChampionTalentData.m_DungeonLivesModifier; in the client data only Expendable Lives (Shin'hare) has one (+2). A lost battle costs a life; losing the last one ends the run (CurState LOSE: the client's Dungeon Lost window, whose OK forfeits the run back to the AZ1 entrance). Castle Crayburn has its own runner and no limit.

The Tranquil Dream._comment: Strength by rank (video: 12, 12, 18, 18, 24 health in runs with different creature orders and answers). Forms by the five tales' answer total: 6 Conquest, 8 Savagery, 11 Retribution are seen on video; the 7/9 limits and Cunning (12-13) / Instinct (14-15) are PLACEHOLDER (Revival PLACEHOLDERS.md:46, never seen).

The Usurper._comment: Shepherd's Rest: Finanif's battle by who died before (Ghuuhg in the Hall of Vermin, Mistsim in the Chamber of Awakening; the scene name spells 'Mistism'); one of the two halls is enough to go on.

The Smoldering Dead._comment: The Thorn Knight's crypt: prying the sarcophagus open (start_encounter) or the statue's curse (choice_wake) wakes him; leaving the room (choice_leave) leaves him alone, and the crypt is not needed for the Burial Vault.

Devonshire Keep._comment: Oratory: prying the ruby out brings the burning zombies (H2), leaving it the dead knight (H1). Minstrel's Gallery: the tripwires disabled (encounter_avoided) is no battle.
